lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with inter-blob spacing increasing along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity aligned with the gill region intersect the horizontal blob rows to form a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges exhibit a sharp pixel intensity gradient, with high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edge and low-luminance shadows on the ventral edge, running parallel to the dorsal-ventral axis transition.
